description: Tall building proposals must be assessed against townscape and skyline impact through defined view corridors; a tower exceeding 30 storeys requires townscape justification.
value: 30 storeys before townscape justification is triggered

description: Podium massing above 6 storeys must step back a minimum of 3 metres from the primary street frontage to protect daylight to opposite buildings.
Development must not cause a material reduction in daylight/sunlight amenity to neighbouring residential windows, assessed using standard VSC methodology.
clause_reference: Local Plan Policy D9.4 / Daylight and Sunlight SPG
value: No material VSC reduction to neighbouring residential windows

description: Ground floor frontage along the primary retail street must be active use (retail, food and beverage, or community use) for a minimum continuous frontage length.
value: Minimum 60% active frontage length along primary street

description: Servicing access must be routed to avoid conflict with peak pedestrian flow along the primary retail street.
value: Servicing route must avoid peak pedestrian conflict windows (08:00-09:30, 17:00-18:30)

description: A minimum of 1,200 sqm of publicly accessible open space must be provided at ground level, connected to the wider public realm strategy.
Major development must demonstrate a credible pathway to net zero operational carbon and report embodied carbon using RICS methodology.
value: Net zero operational carbon pathway + RICS embodied carbon reporting

description: Pre-application advice noted that a stepped massing strategy responding to the podium/tower relationship would be looked upon favourably, though this is guidance rather than a binding requirement.
